notes: Official BrightSign HD5-series datasheet (2024) covers the HD225 (Standard I/O Package) alongside its sibling HD1025 (Expanded I/O Package) with front/rear hardware diagrams and a feature comparison table. The HD1025 adds a rear USB-A port (5V/1A output, e.g. for touchscreens) and a front 3.5mm Serial port that the HD225 explicitly does NOT have — confirmed by the datasheet's diagram callouts "(HD1025 only)". HDMI output is version 2.0a. Ethernet is Gigabit (mapped to eth-1g; no exact tri-speed 10/100/1000 grade exists in the allowed scale). GPIO is a 12-pin Phoenix-style terminal block with 8 bi-directional GPIO signal pins — mapped to the closest connector id "euroblock". Audio Out is a single 3.5mm jack supporting either analog stereo or SPDIF digital passthrough (modeled as trs-3.5 with toslink as an accepted alternate signal on the same physical jack). IR is a 3.5mm mini-jack In/Out. Power is a locking 12V/3A barrel-style external DC connector, modeled as dc-barrel. An internal M.2 E-key Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module with 2 external antenna connectors is optional and not modeled as a signal port. SVC and Reset are recessed internal buttons, not connectors, and are omitted. Dimensions 205 x 185.9 x 19.2 mm (desktop/wall-mount puck form factor, not rack-mountable).
